notes.title: Game updated! Name of series changed and new playable ships.
notes.content:
Commanders!

We have updated the name of the game to "Battlevoid: Harbinger". This had to be done due to a trademark dispute with another fellow gaming company. 

[list]
    [*] New ALIEN ships to play with, unlock by collecting blueprints from enemy ships!
    [*] A new human ship to play with, called BSE Trademark to celebrate this event.
    [*] More ships added to reinforcements.
[/list]

[h1]Get the game here if you are new: [/h1][url=store.steampowered.com/app/396480] Battlevoid: Harbinger on Steam[/url]

Please don't start spreading information of who might have caused the cease and decist. We want to put this behind us now. We will delete such speculative posts.  I hope you can respect our wish to move on quickly from this and continue working on a brighter future! :) 

The best way you can help us is by joining our community and supporting us with our future endeavors. We hope to create even more enticing games in the future for you!

[*] A new human ship to play with, called BSE Trademark to celebrate this event.
[*] More ships added to reinforcements.

notes.title: Trademark troubles, help us decide on a new name. New update coming to Harbinger.
notes.content:
Commanders!

We have 3 weeks to change the "Battlestation" name to something else, we need your help!

It has come to our attention that we made a mistake a long time ago by choosing the name "Battlestation" for our game series. This name is entirely too close to another series and the mistake is ours, we take full responsibility for this. We did not know the rules of how trademarks works, we were just excited to create games and came up with a name that we thought was fitting for the series. You live and you learn.

We do not want any harm to the company that notified us, so please don't attack anybody. They were very kind with us and did not press any financial actions against us. We don't think the name impacted our sales in any way, but it was still generous of them to be kind with us.

[h1]New name![/h1]

Now we need your help! We need suggestions on a name that we could use instead of "Battlestation".
[list]
[*]The name cannot have "battlestation" in it in any way, but some form derived from "Battle" is ok as long as it is not too close to "Battlestation".
[*]The name should be fitting and describe the series, bonus points if it can inhabit a wide variety of new games we create as well.
[/list]
A couple of our own ideas:
[list]
[*]Battleversum
[*]Astroverse
[/list]

[h1]New Update![/h1]

Now for the positive, we are going to push a small update to Battlestation: Harbinger (Which will be (new name): Harbinger) in unison with the name change! We call this the magnificent "Trademark update":
[list]
[*]New Human space ship named "BSE Trademark", with the letters TM written all over it, to celebrate this blunder.
[*]Unlock and play with Alien ships! To celebrate the world of trademarks you can now "trademark" those pesky alien ships. Many of you have mentioned wanting to  play with alien ships, your wish will come true!
[*]As a bonus, some ships from the ship menu unlock list will be added to reinforcement ship list.
[/list]

Please write your suggestions below for a new name to the "Battlestation" series, thank you for being with us! We cannot promise any name to be chosen, and we have to do a search to make sure it is free for use, but we want to hear all your ideas!

You can read more at our forums here: [url=http://bugbyte.fi/forums/showthread.php?tid=220]Bugbyte Forums[/url]

notes.title: Sixth patch! 1.5.0. Bug fixes and Bugbyte ID, Cross-platform cloud save system.
notes.content:
Game now supports cloud save! And to celebrate we are having a big midweek sale on all platforms. So click the "Store" button up right and see what this epic space strategy game is all about, Commander!

Additions:

- Cross-platform cloud saves with Bugbyte ID. Set it up under the cloud save button in main menu and you can save your progress to the cloud.
- Fixed Teleport bug
- Added a new Battlestation name
- Fixed escape pod

[b]If you have problems read the Known Issues and Solutions thread first:[/b]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396480/discussions]Battlestation: Harbinger Steam Community Discussions[/url]

[b]Then contact support@bugbyte.fi if everything else fails.[/b]

notes.title: Known issues and solutions
notes.content:
[h1]Problem:[/h1]

Game doesn't start

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

Try turning anti-virus off. If it doesn't work contact support@bugbyte.fi, preferably with a crash report if you have one.

[h1]Problem:[/h1]

Can't cllick on anything in the game

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

Set user interface scaling to 100% in your operating system.

Can't cllick on anything in the game

notes.title: First patch, 1.4.5! Look here if you have problems.
notes.content:
Hi! We are working on all the reported problems, we will try to fix everything ASAP. Please be patient with us and you can always contact us at support@bugbyte.fi

- fixed a few bugs that causes crashes.
- added option to linux to disable cursors
- fixed point defense turrets to not track targets outside of firing arc.
- fixed scrolling so it shouldn't get stuck anymore
- We are working on all of the reported crash and other issues! Thank you for your patience!

FAQ:

[h1]Problem:[/h1]

Game doesn't start

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

1. Reboot Machine/Steam

2. Try turning anti-virus off. 

3. Apparently, win10 isnt correctly using the Java enviroment packaged with the game:

The fix is below:

Navigate to Java's site and download Recommended Version 8 Update 73 (filesize: 718 KB)\

2. Navigate to the JAR file in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Battlestation Harbinger (Harbinger.jar)

3. A launcher will open for you to select resolution etc.

4. Play

If the two above doesn't work contact support@bugbyte.fi, preferably with a crash report if you have one.

[h1]Linux Problem:[/h1]

Starting game gives an "java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError"

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

Install package xorg-xrandr from repository

[h1]Problem:[/h1]

Can't click on anything in the game

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

Set user interface scaling to 100% in your operating system.

[h1]Problem:[/h1]

Surface pro or other machine. Graphics are scaled wrong on the screen.

[h1]Solution:[/h1]

Go to where you have Battlestation Harbinger installed, typically “C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Battlestation Harbinger” right click on harbinger.exe file and select properties, then go to the Compatibility tab at the top and check “Disable display scaling on high DPI settings” near the bottom.

notes.title: Battlestation: Harbinger arrives on Steam February 24th!
notes.content:
Commanders!

I’m here asking for your help. Once again we stand against a formidable enemy, the upcoming PC release is incredibly important for this small indie game company. The future of Battlestation is on the line.

We have now added:
[list]
[*]An Endless mode for each difficulty level
[*]8 new playable ships
[*]A few new turrets and facilities
[*]+ Whatever we can manage in the upcoming weeks
[/list]

The PC release will be launched as the fully fledged out Extended Edition, after this we need around 2 weeks to update the mobile version. Future updates of Harbinger and the future of the Battlestation series depend on the success of the upcoming PC release, we need your help to get visibility. The industry is brutal for small indie game companies like us, and often a fight of survival.

Commanders, here are 3 ways you can help:
[list]
[*]Share the launch trailer wherever you can: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cov__t-SNkA
[*]Join this Thunderclap campaign: http://thndr.me/Gtaanu
[*]And the biggest help you can give: Be with us February 24th, and play Harbinger on PC!

[/list]

Watching this community grow has been a special time for me, and we will do our best to continue making great games for you in the future. I hope you are with us February 24th, Commander!

NOTE! We need around 2 weeks of time to update and test the mobile version after the PC release. Hope you understand.

notes.title: Battlestation: Harbinger will receive a Christmas update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

It is my pleasure to announce that Battlestation: Harbinger will receive a Christmas update on mobile, where we have added a lot of the Extended Edition Content.

This will not be the final Extended Edition version! It will be all the content we have had time to implement so far, and the game will be a little rough around the edges because of this. Please be gentle with us, since the game might not be perfectly balanced yet and may have some bugs. We feel that we want to give you a nice Christmas present and that's why we want to give you this update.

And for all the PC users, who chose early access on Kickstarter. You fine Commanders will receive the Early Access PC version before Christmas as well. We will contact you through our Kickstarter.

Be sure to check out our first teaser trailer of Battlestation: Harbinger Extended Edition, you will be playing it very soon! What do you think? Give us your comments here and on the video, we really want to hear from you:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=561573296

Give us a thumbs up on everything you like! And your comments =)
